## The parameterised report idea

One `.qmd` with a `params:` block, plus a `purrr::walk()` loop over district names,
produces thirty district reports. That is the whole trick, and it is the single
highest-return thing in this workshop for anyone who produces recurring outputs.

## What you should be able to do by 16:30

- render one source document to HTML, PDF and slides
- parameterise a report and batch-render it
- build a dashboard from an existing analysis
- publish the result to a URL you can share
